title: Distance from constant strings
statement: For a nonempty Boolean string $w\colon\{1,\ldots,n\}\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$, define its distance from the constant strings to be the minimum of the uniform proportions of coordinates equal to false and equal to true.
